context: A boss and his manager discuss a transport-policy article
purpose: Teach: 交通省/官邸/直線/遠隔/無関心/団地/下降/上流

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、交通省の方針が官邸主導で変わった話だな。
lines.en: This article—it's about how MLIT policy shifted under cabinet direction.
lines.style: Measured, analytical opening. Light tap of recognition on 'This article.' Leans back slightly, reading tone. Pulls back to observe the broader pattern. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新直線高速の予算、上流の供給網にも波及しています。
lines.en: Yes. The new highway budget is already affecting upstream supply chains.
lines.style: Attentive, precise. Delivers the connection with quiet certainty—no hedging. Maintains professional eye contact. Clean, efficient pacing. The confidence of someone who has done the legwork.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地方団地の住民、無関心傾向が顕著だな。
lines.en: What strikes me is how indifferent the residents in those housing complexes have become.
lines.style: Observational, almost concerned. Slight pause before 'indifferent'—letting the word land. Quiet conviction underneath. Reading people as much as policy. Measured, not alarmed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 遠隔会議で住民説明を進める案も出ています。
lines.en: They're considering remote town-hall meetings to engage them.
lines.style: Clear, informational delivery. Steady tone—offering solution-side context. No apology in the phrasing. Professional precision. Slight forward lean, like presenting evidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 参加率が下降してるからな、対策必須だ。
lines.en: Participation's already dropping. So we need to act.
lines.style: Firmer edge now. Light weight on 'already'—emphasis that time matters. Not harsh, but decisive. This is directive, not suggestion. Sits forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Crisp, clean closure. Single nod in the voice. No elaboration—just confirmation of receipt and readiness. Professional boundary, clean exit.
